name: curios
description: Unusual objects with narrative, mysterious, personal, or situational interest

fields.name: Whispering compass
fields.description: A strange compass that quietly complains whenever it points north.

fields.name: Everlasting candle
fields.description: A candle whose small flame never consumes its wax.

fields.name: Mysterious sealed letter
fields.description: A letter addressed to someone the character has never met.

fields.name: RULE Book
fields.description: A rare treatise discussing {{ rules.name }}, its possible uses, and the risks of misinterpretation.

fields.name: Unknown Key
fields.description: A key with no known lock, marked by a symbol tied to an organization or building.

fields.name: Coded Notes
fields.description: Pages whose meaning depends on a code, missing context, or absent person.

fields.name: Treasure Map
fields.description: An incomplete route with old landmarks, warnings, and an ambiguous destination.

fields.name: Ceremonial Doll
fields.description: A cloth figure bearing an erased name and traces of an old ritual.

fields.name: Locked Grimoire
fields.description: A book protected by a lock or riddle whose contents cannot be read directly.

fields.name: Old Toy
fields.description: A toy or stuffed bear recognizable to a family, collector, or spirit.

fields.name: Incomplete Manuscript
fields.description: A historical or scientific text with pages deliberately removed.

fields.name: Sealed Vase
fields.description: A fragile container whose contents produce an unusual sound or warmth.

fields.name: Enchanted Toothbrush
fields.description: An absurdly specific tool that cleans teeth perfectly and bites other dirt.

fields.name: Unidentified Egg
fields.description: A living egg whose species, needs, and danger remain unknown.

fields.name: Attuned Stone
fields.description: A mineral or magical stone reacting to a place, person, or particular RULE.

fields.name: Travel Chicken
fields.description: An unusually calm chicken trained to follow its carrier and signal certain creatures.

fields.name: Runed amulet
fields.description: An amulet engraved with a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.

fields.name: Runed ring
fields.description: A ring engraved with a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.

fields.name: Runed cloak
fields.description: A cloak embroidered with a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.

fields.name: Runed boots
fields.description: A pair of boots marked with a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.

fields.name: Runed mirror
fields.description: A hand mirror carrying a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.

fields.name: Runed key
fields.description: A key carrying a rune of {{ rules.name }}; its precise function is left to the GM.
